title: Advertiser/Investor portals open to members & providers — exit returns to your own portal
notes: General Users and Service Providers can now open the Advertise and Invest account pages and the exit/back links (Portal, Member Portal, Back to 2k2) return them to the portal they belong to: members to the GU portal, providers to the Provider portal, admins to Admin
Exit links on advertise.html + invest.html rewrite themselves from the signed-in role
